description: Distance and direction between WGS-84 coordinates: geodesic distance by Vincenty with a haversine fallback, initial and final bearing, the midpoint, and the destination point reached from a start point on a given bearing and distance. Also computes the cumulative length of a supplied coordinate path. Results in metres, kilometres, nautical miles and miles. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

bearing.description: Initial bearing in degrees for op=destination. Accepted: number 0-360.

distance_m.description: Distance in metres for op=destination, 0 to 1e9 (about 25 Earth circumferences); larger values are 400 INVALID_PARAM. Accepted: a number between 0 and 1e9 (metres).

lat1.description: Start latitude. Accepted: a number between -90 and 90.

lat2.description: End latitude. Accepted: a number between -90 and 90.

lon1.description: Start longitude. Accepted: a number between -180 and 180.

lon2.description: End longitude. Accepted: a number between -180 and 180.

method.description: vincenty (default, WGS-84) or haversine. Accepted: vincenty, haversine.

op.description: distance (default), destination, midpoint or path. Accepted: distance, destination, midpoint, path.

path.description: Comma-separated lat,lon pairs for op=path, at most 200 points. Accepted: comma-separated lat,lon pairs, at most 200 points.

name: geo_distance
title: Geodesic distance, initial bearing and destination point on WGS-84
